title: NumPy asarray adjustable arguments
interactions: The deterministic owner supplies and validates array data separately; C order is explicit for hashed payloads.
assumptions: The current API slice covers float64 calculations and little-endian float64 or uint32 payloads.
warnings: This spec does not authorize casting unverified data.
failure_modes: Unsupported dtype, order, or unavailable locked NumPy distribution.
